title: kh0pper/crow
summary: kh0pper/crow是一个模块化、代理框架和MCP平台，允许用户自托管。用户可以构建和运行自己的AI代理，连接Claude Code、Claude Desktop或Cursor作为原生MCP连接器，自托管应用程序，并通过加密P2P共享。该框架支持本地或云模型，开源，适用于构建AI代理和自托管应用。
description: Modular, agentic framework and MCP platform you self-host. Build and run your own AI agents, connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or Cursor as a native MCP connector, self-host your apps, and share over encrypted P2P — on hardware you own, with local or cloud models. Open source.
